relevant_laws.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to park a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter upon a street other than upon the roadway against the curb or upon the sidewalk in a rack to support the bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter or against a building or at the curb, in such a manner as to afford the least obstruction to pedestrian traffic.
relevant_laws.notes: Frozen parking cell; actual rack support, device identity, placement and pedestrian corridor require original sources.
